quizName:
Hardest Questions in Wyoming
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: Which driving skills are affected by alcohol and/or drugs?
questions.explanation: Alcohol and drugs hurt many driving skills. They slow reaction time, reduce coordination, lower alertness, and make it hard to concentrate.

questions.question: Like alcohol and drugs, drowsiness can:

options.text: Help you be a better driver.

questions.explanation: Lack of sleep causes poor driving. Sleepiness slows your reaction time, lowers your awareness, and hurts your judgment, just like drugs and alcohol.

questions.question: If you get tired while driving, you should:

options.text: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.
questions.explanation: Take breaks every hour on long trips. If possible, share driving duties with another person so you can sleep while they drive.

questions.question: At a crosswalk:

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crossings. You must stop for pedestrians in a crosswalk, whether it is marked or unmarked.

questions.question: If you see animals near the road while driving, you should:

options.text: Speed up to scare them away.
Slow down and proceed with caution.
Quickly swerve into the next lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: Slow down if you see animals near the road. They may suddenly move or change direction. Animals often travel in groups, so more may be nearby.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Only go when it is safe. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: Which driving skills are affected by alcohol and/or drugs?
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your nervous system. It reduces alertness and concentration, increases reaction time, and damages coordination.

questions.question: If you feel drowsy while driving, you should:
questions.explanation: Drive to the nearest rest stop to take a break, nap, stretch, or switch drivers. Caffeine pills and energy drinks are not a real replacement for rest.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed at this location. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. Right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and other roads where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp going the wrong direction.

questions.question: If a traffic light is green but a police officer signals you to stop, what should you do?

options.text: Do what the vehicle in front of you does.

questions.explanation: Always obey a police officer's directions, even if they conflict with traffic signals, signs, or road markings.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed at this location. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to areas where bicycles, animals, or people are likely to cross the road.

questions.question: If you encounter an aggressive driver, what should you do?
questions.explanation: When you see an aggressive driver, the safest choice is to get out of their way. Never try to compete with other drivers. Always respect other road users.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up to reach your destination faster.
Turn up the volume of your radio.
Find a safe parking area and take a short nap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Find a safe parking area and take a short nap.
questions.explanation: If you struggle to keep your eyes open, drift from your lane, or need to turn up the radio to stay awake, you are too tired to drive safely. Find a safe place to park and take a short nap to refresh yourself.

questions.question: A school bus ahead has flashing lights and its signal arm extended. What should you do?

options.text: Go at 15 mph if no children are visible.
Drive at normal speed, but watch for children.

questions.explanation: When a school bus has flashing lights and its arm extended, you must stop completely. Stay stopped until the arm goes back and the bus moves. This rule applies whether you are going the same direction or coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: You must yield to a pedestrian with a white cane or guide dog:

options.text: Only when the guide dog is leading the person across the street.
Only if a crossing guard is present.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians using guide dogs or white canes must have the right-of-way at all times.

questions.question: You see flashing red lights at a railroad crossing. What should you do?

options.text: Drive faster than the approaching train.
Look for a way around any lowered gates.

questions.explanation: Railroad crossing signs warn drivers about trains. You must obey all railroad crossing warning signs and lights. Never try to drive around barriers.

questions.question: Your car breaks down on an interstate and you must stop. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn to get other drivers' attention.
Get out and flag down the first car that passes.
Pull off the road, turn on emergency flashers, and stay in your car if possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the road, turn on emergency flashers, and stay in your car if possible.
questions.explanation: Pull onto the shoulder, turn on your emergency flashers to warn other drivers, and stay in your vehicle if you can. Walking or standing on an interstate is very dangerous because of high-speed traffic.

questions.question: What does excessive speed do?

options.text: Saves time so you arrive faster.
Increases the chance of serious injury and death.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increases the chance of serious injury and death.
questions.explanation: Excessive speed is a major cause of car crashes. It does not save time and often leads to poor decisions while driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is beginning ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. Round signs are only used to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: You just had an argument and feel very angry. What should you do before driving?

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you don't think about the argument.
Take a few minutes to calm down.
Drive on the interstate to release your anger.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down.
questions.explanation: Emotions affect your ability to drive safely. If you are angry, excited, scared, worried, or sad, calm down before driving. You need to focus fully on driving.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will enter your lane from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: You can identify an aggressive driver by:

options.text: The number of passengers in their car.

questions.explanation: Watch other drivers while you drive. If you see a driver making erratic or improper lane changes, they may be aggressive. The safest choice is to stay away from them.

questions.question: Work zone barriers, drums, cones, and signs are used to:

options.text: Make drivers angry about slow traffic.
Keep traffic out of hazardous work zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep traffic out of hazardous work zones.
questions.explanation: Work zones are dangerous for workers and drivers. Watch for cones, barrels, signs, large vehicles, and workers in bright vests to warn you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows you cannot turn in the direction of the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign warns you of:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake problems.

questions.question: If a police officer is directing traffic at a working traffic light, drivers should:
questions.explanation: Traffic signals control traffic at intersections. Drivers, pedestrians, and cyclists must obey them. If an officer is directing traffic, follow their directions instead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same direction will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: If you become tired while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: If you become tired while driving, stop to rest or change drivers. Tiredness slows your reactions and makes driving unsafe.

questions.question: If you drink several beers, alcohol effects will only go away by:
questions.explanation: Only time removes alcohol from your body. Coffee, exercise, or cold showers do not speed this up. One drink takes about one hour to wear off.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: In a car with airbags, where should children age 12 and under sit?

options.text: The bed of a pick-up truck.

questions.explanation: Airbags can injure children. Children age 12 and under should always sit in the back seat of a car with airbags.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing with lowered gates and flashing lights, you should:

options.text: Drive around the crossing gates if you can't see a train.
Come to a complete stop well behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, and proceed once the gates are lifted.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop well behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, and proceed once the gates are lifted.
questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing with warning signs or flashing lights. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: You want to turn right, but a pedestrian with a guide dog is crossing in front of you. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off your engine until the person crosses the street.
Tell the pedestrian when to cross the street.
Wait until the person crosses the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the person crosses the street.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians using guide dogs must always have the right-of-way. Let them cross before you turn.

questions.question: When driving in work zones, you should:

options.text: Follow the driver in front of you closely.
Pass the driver in front of you as soon as you can.
Avoid tailgating and keep a safe following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid tailgating and keep a safe following distance.
questions.explanation: In work zones, keep a safe distance from barriers, trucks, equipment, workers, and other vehicles. Do not tailgate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means no left turns here.

questions.question: A truck or bus is turning right where you also need to turn right. What should you do?

options.text: Quickly turn before the truck or bus is able to.
Wait until the truck or bus turns before you turn.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus turns before you turn.
questions.explanation: Do not squeeze between a turning truck or bus and the curb. This causes crashes. Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means no left turns are allowed. You cannot turn left at an intersection with this sign.
